value.rationale: A fully parameterized natural regular language with one marked letter makes the dependence of determinization on coprimality visible. The exact quotient explains the systematic collapse from exponential to linear, supplies all reachable and minimal state counts, and can benchmark subset construction and minimization. It is not merely an arbitrary fixed-size census, renaming or generic upper bound.
